caption: The drawing shows a single object placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object is a vertical wooden structure with a worn, cracked texture, colored in various shades of brown and grey. The base is a roughly cut, thick piece of wood set flat on the ground, with pronounced grain lines and visible age cracks. Rising vertically from the base are three straight wooden rods that support two horizontal, hexagonal wooden plates—one near the base and one about halfway up the rods. A fourth, central wooden rod runs up the middle, fitted with a row of regularly spaced, angular notches along one side, resembling a saw blade. At the top, these rods support a third, smaller hexagonal wooden plate, which holds a short, stubby white candle with brownish melted wax evident on its sides. The entire structure is depicted with careful attention to wood grain, color variation, and aging. There is a small, handwritten signature and date near the bottom right of the image.
title: Candle Stand
